verdict.rationale: Flagsmith documents Feature Change Requests as a four-eyes create/approve/publish workflow for flag updates, similar to GitHub pull requests. Release Pipelines can automatically generate change requests when promoting flags to production, and RBAC can restrict who may modify production environments. Missing for 10: documentation of how change requests are enforced as mandatory per environment (e.g., minimum approver counts or required reviewers), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the approval workflow.
